description: Regression suites every implemented PHP profile must pass. Adding a release to internal/profile requires an entry here for both integer widths; internal/profile TestEveryImplementedProfileHasRegressionSuites enforces it. Suites name Go test functions that must exist in the repository.

known_gaps: Cross-cycle WeakReference resurrection remains compatibility-blocked: pinned arm64 PHP exits 139 and i386 exposes an invalid externally held object. The user approved keeping Go owner safety and merging PR #73 with this explicit limit. This diagnostic is never a compatibility pass (docs/implementation/evidence/W-13-gc-weak-diagnostic.json).

Consecutive lazy rollback reentrant writes remain compatibility-blocked: pinned arm64 PHP exits 133 with zend_mm_heap corrupted; i386 also corrupts memory and times out under local emulation. Independent declared/dynamic cases match exactly. The user approved merging with this explicit limit; the consecutive diagnostic is never a pass (docs/implementation/evidence/W-13-lazy-rollback-diagnostic.json).
